subject: Quick thought on Quality Dental Care's mobile booking
body: Hi Quality Dental Care team, I came across your practice while looking at local family clinics in Omaha and wanted to reach out. I love that you have been treating patients like family since 2006, especially with your same-day emergency care and sedation options for anxious patients. When browsing your current site on my phone, I noticed that the main contact number is a bit tucked away, and it lacks an instant online booking widget or a sticky click-to-call mobile banner for those urgent needs. I went ahead and put together a modern, live prototype for your practice to show how a cleaner layout and instant mobile click-to-call could boost your patient inquiries. You can check out the live preview here: https://nayom-biz-0x8793f265a02e9bdf-0xdefab5488f25fbe.vercel.app. If you would like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I would be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you are happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Added a sticky click-to-call phone banner for mobile viewports
Streamlined patient booking and embedded direct Google Reviews trust signals
